2842-4681-5170-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Blood Artist triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Blood Artist trigger.
Resolve the Blood Artist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Repeat.

2034-4812-6867.description:
Cast Animate Dead by paying its mana cost, returning Appa from your graveyard to the battlefield with Animate Dead attached to it.
When Appa enters, it triggers, airbending Animate Dead.
Animate Dead triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Appa, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Animate Dead ability, doing nothing.
Cast Animate Dead from exile by paying {2}, returning Appa from your graveyard to the battlefield with Animate Dead attached to it.
Repeat from step 2.

3480-4316-5078-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-3249-6723-6920--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-3249-6723-6920--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from A Realm Reborn by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from A Realm Reborn by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the creature castable for one mana from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature spell from your graveyard by paying it mana cost.
When you cast that creature or when it enters, Silk triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

728-5276-6412.description:
Cast Leonin Relic-Warder by paying {W}{W}.
When Leonin Relic-Warder enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Pre-War Formalwear.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Leonin Relic-Warder.
When Leonin Relic-Warder dies, its second ability triggers, returning Pre-War Formalwear from exile to the battlefield.
When Pre-War Formalwear enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Leonin Relic-Warder from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attaching Pre-War Formalwear to it.
When Leonin Relic-Warder enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Pre-War Formalwear.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability from step 3.
Repeat from step 3.

109-223.manaNeeded: {R}{R} plus the cost of the additional sorcery
109-223.notablePrerequisites: You have an additional castable sorcery.
109-223.description:
Cast any sorcery by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Fork by paying its mana cost.
Kalamax's first and second abilities trigger.
Resolve the first ability, creating a copy of Fork and choosing to copy the original Fork.
Resolve the second ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Kalamax.
Resolve the Fork copy, creating a copy of Fork.
Kalamax's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Repeat from step 6 any number of times.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

2411-3259-5223.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2411-3259-5223.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Lathril, triggering Breath of Fury and Lathril.
Resolve the Lathril trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

1495-4120-7704.easyPrerequisites: Triskelion has a +1/+1 counter on it.
1495-4120-7704.description:
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter on it, targeting itself, but putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Vigor.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter on it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
1495-4120-7704.notes: You may also target your other creatures in step 2 to put +1/+1 counters on them due to Vigor.

141-2292-7364.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-2292-7364.description:
Cast Continue? by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Continue?.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Continue?
Resolve the Continue? copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
141-2292-7364.notes: You can sacrifice up to three additional creatures and return them using Continue? each loop.

1350-4010-4460-6723.description:
Cast Farmer Cotton by paying at least {4}{G}{W}
When Farmer Cotton enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least four 1/1 Halfling creature tokens and four Food tokens.
Activate Farmer Cotton, four Halflings and four Foods by tapping them, adding {6}{G}{W}{W}.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning Farmer Cotton from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
1350-4010-4460-6723.notes: It is recommended to pay at least {1} additional to start to get infinite untapped tokens. This mana will be recuperated throughout the combo.

uses.n: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

1690-2538-4668-5034.notablePrerequisites:
You have an artifact card in hand that can be cast for {0} due to Heliod
Opponents have drawn at least one card this turn.
1690-2538-4668-5034.description:
Activate Sol Ring by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Words of Wind by paying {1}.
Cast an artifact by paying {0}.
Jhoira triggers, causing each player to return a permanent they control from the battlefield to their hand due to Words of Wind, with you returning Sol Ring to your hand.
Activate Words of Wind by paying {1}.
Cast Sol Ring by paying {0}.
Jhoira triggers, causing each player to return a permanent they control from the battlefield to their hand due to Words of Wind, with you returning the artifact cast in step 3 to your hand.
Repeat.
1690-2538-4668-5034.notes: You can use a historic creature to get infinite ETB and LTB triggers. If you do not use a creature, this combo will not produce those results.

3703-6798-7084.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Sporemound triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

1402-1879-2218-4763.description:
Cast Diamond Lion by paying {2}.
When Diamond Lion enters, Ronin Warclub triggers, attaching itself to Diamond Lion.
Activate Diamond Lion by tapping it, sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding three mana of any color.
When Diamond Lion dies, Koll triggers, returning Diamond Lion from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1379-1651-5640-6857.description:
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping it and Kragma Butcher, targeting Kragma Butcher.
Ertha Jo triggers, copying Clock of Omens' ability, targeting Clock of Omens.
Resolve both Clock of Omens  abilities, untapping it and Kragma Butcher.
Kragma Butcher triggers, giving it +2/+0 until end of turn.
Repeat.

67-1676-1818-5670-6917.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
67-1676-1818-5670-6917.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Reveillark.
When Reveillark dies, it triggers, returning Seedship Broodtender and Boss's Chauffeur from your graveyard to the battlefield. Boss's Chauffeur will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it equal to the number of creatures you control.
When Seedship Broodtender enters, it, Healer of the Pride and Boss's Chauffeur trigger.
Resolve the Healer of the Pride trigger, causing you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Boss's Chauffeur trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Boss's Chauffeur.
Resolve the Seedship Broodtender trigger, causing you to mill three cards.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Boss's Chauffeur.
When Boss's Chauffeur dies, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Citizen creature token for each +1/+1 counter on it.
When the Citizens enter, Healer of the Pride triggers that many times, causing you to gain twice that much life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing a Citizen, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat step 12 two additional times.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{B}{G}.
Activate Seedship Broodtender by paying {3}{B}{G} and sacrificing it, returning Reveillark from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Reveillark enters, Healer of the Pride triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat.
67-1676-1818-5670-6917.notes: You must control an additional creature to get infinite +1/+1 counters on Boss's Chauffeur, infinite mana and infinite creature tokens.

2292-2523-5297.description:
Activate Sarkhan's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing it to become a legendary 4/4 Dragon creature with flying, indestructible and haste.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Sarkhan.
When Sarkhan dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a token copy of Sarkhan that isn't legendary.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat using the Sarkhan token.

1762-4871-5173-5626-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Shambling Ghast.
When Shambling Ghast dies, it, Pitiless Plunderer and Wilhelt's first ability trigger.
Resolve the Shambling Ghast and Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Wilhelt trigger, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token with decayed.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability from step 1
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}, sacrificing the Zombie token, and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Shambling Ghast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

813-957-2061.description:
Cast Time Stretch by paying its mana cost, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Extravagant Replication triggers, creating a token copy of Scholar of the Ages.
When the Scholar of the Ages token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Stretch from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat during your second turn.

2921-3391-4871-6019.description:
Activate Korozda Guildmage's second ability by paying {2}{B}{G} and sacrificing Scourge of Nel Toth.
When Scourge of Nel Toth dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Korozda Guildmage ability, creating six 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing a Saproling.
When the Saproling dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 4 two additional times.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}{B}{G}.
Cast Scourge of Nel Toth from your graveyard by paying {B}{B} and sacrificing two Saprolings.
When the Saprolings die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Repeat.

719-2292-4338.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing any other creature.
When the creature dies as a Cleric due to Xenograft, Rotlung Reanimator triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

3753-4050-4424.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Gudul Lurker, adding {U}.
When Gudul Lurker dies, Missy's first ability triggers, returning Gudul Lurker from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a 2/2 Cyberman artifact creature.
Activate Gudul Lurker's morph ability by paying {U}, turning it face up.
Repeat.

1742-1978-3363-5089.notablePrerequisites: The One Ring has a burden counter on it and does not have summoning sickness.
1742-1978-3363-5089.description:
Animate The One Ring using Karn, the Great Creator.
Activate The One Ring by tapping it, putting a burden counter on it and drawing a card for each burden counter on it.
Activate Skirge Familiar twice by discarding two cards, adding {B}{B}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping The One Ring.
Repeat from step 2.

251-1494-2963.notablePrerequisites: Denry Klin has at least five +1/+1 counters on it.
251-1494-2963.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Teleportation Circle triggers, blinking Sage of Hours.
Sage of Hours enters the battlefield, triggering Denry Klin, putting at least five +1/+1 counters on Sage of Hours.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

224-1671-2248.description:
Activate Skyshroud Ranger by tapping it, putting Simic Growth Chamber from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters the battlefield, it and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Skyshroud Ranger.
Repeat.

3575-4381.notablePrerequisites:
Aerie Ouphes does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
There is a creature with flying on the battlefield.
3575-4381.description:
Activate Aerie Ouphes by sacrificing it, targeting any creature with flying.
When Aerie Ouphes dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with no -1/-1 counter on it due to Grumgully the Generous.
Holding priority, repeat from step 1.
Resolve all Aerie Ouphes abilities, dealing infinite damage to the targeted creature(s).
